description: PHP libraries for the html5 language. 'composer update' in this directory writes them to add/vendor, which genapp copies into every application. The platform section is the runtime they are resolved for: the oldest supported PHP (8.1) and the mongodb and zmq extensions of dockerfiles/php8designer. sys/ga_db_lib_v7.php uses mongodb/mongodb, util/msg-wsserver.php Ratchet and react/zmq, util/googleoauth_header.php the Google client (only its Oauth2 service is kept), sys/mail.php PHPMailer, abaco/abacolib.php Requests.
